This is not quite what was asked, but I want to contrast some other replies with my own story. I want to know what Blake is doing these days.

He was a real nice kid, heart of gold, but life did not favor Blake. You see, he was Ralph Wiggum before the Simpsons were even a thing on the Tracy Ullman show.

Blake, when I fist met him, was eating paste whilst building something out of construction paper. He did this until the fourth grade. In Grade 3, Blake was made to personally fund the Pencil Grip supply, mainly because he ate those too. In grade 2 he was down with those pink and blue rubber erasers, preferring blue because it was grittier (yay for pique!). A dog never ate, Blake's homework, mainly because he got to it first. I tried not to judge him too much on eating the pencils, because damn those hard not to chew on even a little bit. So...when Blake wasn't eating implements, he was eating regular food and stuffing leftovers in his desk to rot. In grade 2 I distinctly remember him currying favor with the ladies, specifically the "new girl" with orange peels wrapped in lined paper. All that aside, Blake was one of the nicest human beings in my class. He was not dumb, or mean, or evil. He just wanted to make friends, be friends, and be himself. I always admired him for that. It's why I wonder what he's up to today. Part of me knows that it may not have gone very well for him.
